import bpy, os
from mathutils import Vector
expected=os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(r'C:\mcp-blender\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'))
if os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(bpy.data.filepath))!=expected: raise RuntimeError('arquivo errado')
# usa o centro XY da torre ativa como referencia
elev=bpy.data.collections.get('01 WORLD | ELEVADOR LACERDA | blockout v4')
if not elev: raise RuntimeError('v4 ausente')
tower=next((o for o in elev.objects if 'torre documental' in o.name.lower()),None)
if not tower: raise RuntimeError('torre ativa ausente')
tc=tower.matrix_world.translation
print(f'TOWER_CENTER={tc.x:.3f},{tc.y:.3f},{tc.z:.3f}')
print('--- OFFICIAL LEGACY OBJECTS NEAR LOWER LEVEL ---')
legacy=bpy.data.collections.get('01 ELEVADOR OFICIAL | esboco original')
if legacy:
    for o in sorted(list(legacy.objects),key=lambda x:x.name):
        if o.type!='MESH': continue
        pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(c) for c in o.bound_box]
        zs=[p.z for p in pts]; xs=[p.x for p in pts]; ys=[p.y for p in pts]
        cx=(min(xs)+max(xs))/2; cy=(min(ys)+max(ys))/2
        d=((cx-tc.x)**2+(cy-tc.y)**2)**0.5
        if min(zs)<=12 or any(k in o.name.lower() for k in ('inferior','baixa','tunel','túnel','acesso')):
            print(f'{o.name}|distXY={d:.2f}|X={min(xs):.2f}..{max(xs):.2f}|Y={min(ys):.2f}..{max(ys):.2f}|Z={min(zs):.2f}..{max(zs):.2f}')
print('--- NEARBY LOW-Z MESHES WITHIN 45m ---')
for o in bpy.data.objects:
    if o.type!='MESH': continue
    if o in elev.objects: continue
    try:
        pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(c) for c in o.bound_box]
    except: continue
    zs=[p.z for p in pts]; xs=[p.x for p in pts]; ys=[p.y for p in pts]
    cx=(min(xs)+max(xs))/2; cy=(min(ys)+max(ys))/2
    d=((cx-tc.x)**2+(cy-tc.y)**2)**0.5
    if d<=45 and min(zs)<=12:
        print(f'NEAR|{o.name}|distXY={d:.2f}|Z={min(zs):.2f}..{max(zs):.2f}|cols={[c.name for c in o.users_collection]}')
print('INSPECT_LOWER_STATION_OK')
